description: Figure 1 illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, and Turkic, listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “# tasks”, represents task count and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  Bars of varying lengths and colors represent the number of tasks for each language family; IE-Slavic is light blue and extends to approximately 70 tasks, IE-Romance is green and extends to approximately 65 tasks, IE-Germanic is yellow and extends to approximately 60 tasks, IE-Baltic is pink and extends to approximately 20 tasks, IE-other is orange and extends to approximately 30 tasks, IE-Indic is purple and extends to approximately 10 tasks, Semitic is red and extends to approximately 10 tasks, and Turkic is brown and extends to approximately 10 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized.
